input.title: Archive thought from context view
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - m
    - x
- b
  - m
    - y
```

1. Activate context view on `a/m`.
2. Set the cursor on `a/m~/b`.
3. Archive thought.

## Current Behavior

Maximum call stack exceeded.

## Expected Behavior

```
- a
  - m
    - x
- b
  - =archive
    - m
      - y
```

## Testing

Fix and unfix test:

https://github.com/cybersemics/em/blob/f68689f6471af07ba87db97cdd9b68bf42cdc910/src/actions/__tests__/archiveThought.ts#L175-L202
